tests.title: Purchase order detail reconciles supplier, warehouse, items, and cost
tests.goal: A CRM user can review purchase order details and reconcile them with the list summary.
preconditions: At least one purchase order with line items exists in staging.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Inventory > Purchase Orders.
Compare its supplier, warehouse, status, line items, quantities, and total cost with the list summary.

expected.text: The detail page identifies the same PO/Lot number and status as the list.
Supplier, warehouse, line items, quantities, and total cost are visible and consistent with the selected record.
